title.description:
The title text of the current section.
It accepts a string or a `UiSdlDynamicValueSpec` object.

subtitle.description:
The subtitle text of the current section.
It accepts a string or a `UiSdlDynamicValueSpec` object.

infoTooltipText.description:
The tooltip text for the info icon.
It accepts a string or a `UiSdlDynamicValueSpec` object.

size.description: The size of the current section header.

actionButtonsCollapseThreshold.description: The collapse threshold to put the actions in the dropdown menu.

actionButtons.description: The action buttons of the current header.
